actions.description: Call device.reset (src/devices/rohde_schwarz_ngmo2.py:85-86). rst writes *RST (lines 81-83) and cls writes *CLS (lines 30-31). The comment on rst says this returns the supply to the *RST default conditions and does not state the output, the voltage, the current or the averaging. An ordinary command: the safety reset does not call it, and it is not a re-enable or a safe-state action. The three cached set points are refused before device.reset is called, including when that call raises, until this driver writes them. The operator confirms the instrument, including whether an output is enabled.

facts.text: The NGMO2 is a dual-channel analyzer/power supply
device builds channel_a, channel_b, display, format and status objects in its constructor
send_command writes one command to the bus for the device address
Channel.voltage accepts 0 to 15 V and rounds to 1 mV
Channel.current accepts 0 to 5 A and rounds to 1 mA; the comment says at most 2.5 A above 5 V
Channel.measure_interval accepts 0.00001 to 1.0 s in 10 us steps
Channel.set_averaging_samples accepts 1 to 10 samples
Channel.on and Channel.off send :OUT:A ON and :OUT:A OFF
Channel.is_on queries :OUTP:A:STAT?
Channel.sense maps sense names to :SENS:A:FUNC
Channel.get_sense queries :SENS:A:FUNC?
Channel.current_range maps range names to :SENS:A:CURR:RANG:UPP
Channel.get_current_range queries :SENS:A:CURR:DC:RANG:UPP?
Channel.get_interval queries :SENS:A:MEAS:INT? and returns a float
Channel.read_voltage selects the volt function, sends :MEAS:A? and reads until LF
Channel.read_current selects the current function, sends :MEAS:A? and reads until LF
device.set_output_format maps ascii, long, short and double to :FORMat:DATA
device.get_output_format queries :FORMat:DATA?
Display.enable writes :DISP:ENAB ON or OFF
Display.enabled queries :DISP:ENAB? and returns a boolean
device.get_idn sends *IDN? and its comment shows the reply format
device.get_status sends *STB?
device.arm sends *ARM
device.reset sends *RST and then *CLS
The comment on device.rst says it returns the power supply to the *RST default conditions
The Prologix adapter accepts GPIB addresses 0 to 30
The Prologix request writes the query and then ++read 10
Display.set_channel builds a command but the TODO on line 281 shows it is never sent
Channel.get_impedance queries the bandwidth command instead of an impedance query

safe_state.description: channel A output off (:OUT:A OFF) and no further actuation sent by this binding
